model.src:
(block System
  :type "Module"
  (sketch "A randomly generated system for testing layout rules.")
  (message Request (sketch "A request."))
  (message Event (sketch "A event."))
  (message Snapshot (sketch "A snapshot."))
  (message Command (sketch "A command."))
  (message Receipt (sketch "A receipt."))
  (behavior Durable (port keep in Event) (sketch "Retains events until acknowledged."))
  (behavior Observable (port metric out Snapshot) (sketch "Reports its own health."))
  (level
    (block RetryRenderer :type "Service"
      (port req in Receipt)
      (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
    (adjacent
      (block LiveAuth :type "Service"
        (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
      (block EdgeUploader :type "Store"
        (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")
        (level
          (block Renderer
            (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")))))
    (adjacent
      (block RetryLedger
        (port in in Event)
        (port done out Request)
        (implements Observable)
        (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
      (block Parser :type "Store"
        (port in in Command)
        (port done out Request)
        (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
      (block Router
        (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen.")))
    (block Planner
      (port evt in Request)
      (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at.")
      (level
        (adjacent
          (block RemoteMetrics
            (port evt in Receipt)
            (port emit out Receipt)
            (implements Observable)
            (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
          (block Uploader :type "Process"
            (port evt in Receipt)
            (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))
          (block EdgeCatalog
            (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))
          (block LiveQueue :type "Store"
            (port req in Snapshot)
            (sketch "Thin wrapper.")))
        (adjacent
          (block BatchCatalog
            (implements Durable)
            (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
          (block ShadowMetrics :type "Process"
            (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key.")
            (level
              (adjacent
                (block BatchScheduler
                  (port req in Receipt)
                  (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
                (block EdgeSearch
                  (implements Durable)
                  (sketch "Fans out each event to every subscriber that asked for its kind."))))
            (level
              (block Cache :type "Feature"
                (port req in Event)
                (implements Observable)
                (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))))
          (block LiveBilling :type "Process"
            (port in in Receipt)
            (port done out Event)
            (implements Durable)
            (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
          (block RetryFeed
            (port evt in Command)
            (port out out Receipt)
            (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at.")
            (level
              (adjacent
                (block Queue
                  (port evt in Snapshot)
                  (port done out Receipt)
                  (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
                (block RemoteSearch
                  (port req in Snapshot)
                  (port out out Receipt)
                  (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
                (block Pricing :type "Service"
                  (port evt in Snapshot)
                  (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))))
            (level
              (adjacent
                (block LiveScheduler
                  (port req in Command)
                  (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
                (block EdgeSync
                  (port evt in Command)
                  (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
                (block Ledger
                  (port req in Event)
                  (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
                (block Scheduler
                  (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at.")))
              (adjacent
                (block Search
                  (port emit out Event)
                  (implements Durable)
                  (sketch "Turns raw input into typed commands and rejects anything malformed before it reaches storage."))
                (block LocalMailer
                  (port evt in Request)
                  (sketch "Thin wrapper.")))))))
      (level
        (block Inbox
          (port in in Snapshot)
          (port out out Command)
          (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen."))
        (block RetryInbox
          (port in in Command)
          (port out out Event)
          (implements Observable)
          (sketch "Thin wrapper.")
          (level
            (adjacent
              (block RetryBilling :type "Store"
                (port in in Event)
                (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
              (block LocalPlanner
                (port evt in Receipt)
                (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at.")))
            (adjacent
              (block RetryCatalog :type "Feature"
                (implements Observable)
                (sketch "Thin wrapper."))
              (block ShadowFeed :type "Feature"
                (port in in Receipt)
                (port out out Command)
                (sketch "Thin wrapper.")))))
        (adjacent
          (block LocalCache
            (implements Observable)
            (sketch "Keeps the latest state per key."))
          (block ShadowScheduler :type "Feature"
            (sketch "Draws the list and only mounts what is on screen.")
            (level
              (block Index
                (sketch "Thin wrapper."))))))))
  (level
    (block EdgePlanner
      (port in in Command)
      (sketch "Retries failed deliveries with backoff, then parks them for a human to look at."))))
